title: backlog-groomer output
description: Canonical machine-readable output contract for the backlog-groomer role. See agents/backlog-groomer.md Step 9 for the prose contract this mirrors.

status.description: BLOCKED means a required input was missing or unusable -- see notes.

identity.description: The identity actually used to scope this run, echoed back for the caller to confirm.

notes.description: Free-text summary, or the missing-input explanation when status is BLOCKED.

sprintSets.description: Responsibility 1b: cohesive sprint-set groupings, plus standalone/collision notes folded into each entry's reason.

duplicates.description: Responsibility 2a: duplicate clusters found, with the survivor and the evidence used to pick it.

issue.description: The quality gap, e.g. missing repro steps, urgency/content mismatch.

needsGrooming.description: Responsibility 2b: high-priority/urgent-sounding beads whose content quality is too low to act on, ordered by priority x quality-gap.

evidence.description: Result of the landed-vs-closed corroboration check (git log hits or lack thereof).

needsVerification.description: Beads whose children are all closed but landing on this branch is unconfirmed -- never treat as done.

chain.description: Resolved blocks chain, e.g. ["X", "Y"] meaning blocked by X, which is blocked by Y.

notYours.description: Only populated when include-others was set. Never merged into identity's own buckets.

command.description: Exact bd command, proposed or run.

reason.description: Evidence and reasoning; mirrors the note attached to the mutation when executed=true.

executed.description: true if dry-run was false and this command was actually run; false if only proposed.

actions.description: Responsibility 3 output: one entry per justified mutation, proposed or executed depending on the dry-run input.

key.description: The groomer-heuristic-<slug> key used with bd remember.
